name: Broken Hall
summary: Beneath the Pool of Tears, Broken Hall lies flooded at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar's outer edge. Ysera and her green dragons dragged the ziggurat beneath the waters, driving the Atal'ai into deeper chambers.

sections.title: Flooded Threshold
sections.body: Murky swamp water covers the floor of Broken Hall. When the green dragons dragged the Atal'ai ziggurat beneath the Pool of Tears, the outer hall suffered most. Its floor collapsed, and the Atal'ai zealots left the flooded chamber for deeper parts of the temple. You must wade through the ruins before climbing the stairs to the Hall of Masks.

faq.answer: Broken Hall is the outer entry chamber of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, just beyond its submerged entrance beneath the Pool of Tears.

faq.q: Why is the Broken Hall flooded and ruined?
faq.answer: The green dragonflight shattered Broken Hall when it dragged the temple beneath the marsh waters to stop the summoning of the Blood God Hakkar. The floor broke, and water filled the chamber.

faq.q: Are there any Atal'ai trolls living in this hall?
faq.answer: Broken Hall lies largely abandoned. After the upper temple drowned, the Atal'ai cultists withdrew to drier, more defensible chambers deeper within the complex.

faq.q: Where do the stairs in the Broken Hall lead?
aliases: where to go from broken hall
faq.answer: The stone stairs out of flooded Broken Hall lead directly to the Hall of Masks.

angles.text: As a troll who reveres the loa, you see Broken Hall as a grim reminder of the ruin brought upon Atal'ai zealots who defied their kind to serve Hakkar the Soulflayer.
